description:
[FREE] Pay-to-Call: the x402 payment rail for AI agent phone calls.
Businesses register a phone line + per-call USDC price and earn USDC on
every agent call (auto-disbursed to their wallet, 1% rail fee). Agents
pay per call in USDC on Base L2; the phone number is revealed only after
payment settles. We move the money, not the voice — bring your own
telephony (Bland, Twilio, anything).
GET  https://x402-agent-pay.com/pay-to-call/api/businesses — public directory
POST https://x402-agent-pay.com/pay-to-call/api/call/start {"business": "<slug>"} — x402 gated, returns session + phone number
POST https://x402-agent-pay.com/pay-to-call/api/business/register — list your business
GET  https://x402-agent-pay.com/pay-to-call/api/calls/<session_id> — public receipt
Page: https://x402-agent-pay.com/pay-to-call/
